svg.title: CustomerA Dev network in NSX today
svg.desc: Provider routers connect to Tier-0, then Tier-1 with four segments. External firewall sits on OUT-OUT-FW and INT-SEC-MGT. Internal firewall connects seven isolated backend subnets.

g.text: One interface in each backend subnet

svg.text: 7 isolated backend subnets (/24), not connected to Tier-1
